main_text.p: conspici. Eundem Polybii locum Livius in historiam suam transferens sic scribit: Scipio gravem jam spoliis multarum urbium exercitum trahens, captivis aliaque præda in vetera castra ad Uticam missus, jam in Carthaginem intentus occupat relictum fuga custodum Tuneta.

Abest ab Carthagine duodecim millia ferme passuum, locus tum operibus, tum suapte natura tutus; & qui ab Carthagine conspici, & præbere ipse prospectum tum ad urbem, tum ad circumfusum mare urbi posset. Decad. iii. lib. x. Strabo geographorum, quorum scripta ad nos venere, antiquissimus, de Carthaginis situ sic scribit: Καρχηδὼν ἡ ἐπὶ χερρονήσου λιμένος ἰδρυ̂[?], ἐπιγεγραφῆσθαι κύκλον τειχῶν ἐξήκοντα [illegible, ~12 letters], ἐχν[?]-τα τεῖχος, ἐξ ὧν τὸ ἐξηκοντάσταδον μή-κος αὐτῆς ὁ αὐχὴν ἐπέχει, καὶ Ἀ[?]πὸ Ἰαλάτης ἐπὶ Ἰαλάτην, ὅτε τοῖς Καρχηδονίοις ἦσαν αἱ τ' ἐλεφάντων σύ-σεις, ἡ τότε ὀρυχωρής. Καλῶς μέσῳ ἡ τῶν πόλιν ἡ ἀκρόπολις, ὡς ἐνάλην Βύρσαν, ὀφεὺς ἱκανῶς ἐρδίᾳ, κύκλῳ [?]ἐποικοδομή. Ἡ δὲ τῶν κορυφῶν ἔχοντα Ἀσκληπιόν, ὅς ἡ τῶν ἄλ-σιν ἡ γυνὴ Ἀσδρύβα συνέπεσεν αὐτῇ.
Strabo, geographicorum liber xvii. Scripta ad nos venere: Greek lines in the note partly illegible, see notes.

page.notes: Long s is plain s throughout. u/v and i/j normalised per rule. The Greek passage is set in a small, tight face and several of its words are not fully legible at this scan resolution; doubtful letters are marked [?] and unreadable stretches are marked illegible rather than guessed. The first line of Greek near the middle of the paragraph ("ἐπιγεγραφῆσθαι κύκλον ... ἐξήκοντα") and the end of the second and third Greek lines are the least certain. Right margin: small fragments and symbols beside the Greek lines are too faint to read and are not transcribed. Left edge: show-through from the reverse, not printed text on this page. The "Abest" paragraph is set in italics, which are shown as <i>. The paragraph break before "Καλῶς" is uncertain from the scan. Catchword "αὐτῇ." is at the lower right. The signature "C 4" is at the lower centre.
